implemented_design: Immutable ComponentSplit owns retained and transferred compensated Amounts, plus a checked scalar write plan that refuses any lost low limb, stale donor or receiver rounding
exact_API_invariant: Portion.moles is public Moles(f64); deposit merges by scalar addition, withdraw_phase debits scalar p.moles - take and returns a scalar Moles. A standalone residual/low-part map would create a second authority while other solvers/persistence still overwrite/read the public scalar. All live donor/receiver writers and persistence must retain one authoritative amount before that split can be committed.
false_authority_controls: Actual SP003 step629 next residue and positive transferred low limb must survive in Amount and be rejected by scalar_write_plan
Independent dyadic 1 - 2^-70 split: both positive owners and exact closure, but scalar writer refuses
Exactly representable .25/.75 split with receiver .5 produces exact .25/1.25 plan
Stale donor, nonfinite/negative balances, overdraw and receiver low-limb loss refuse
